intro: The air grows thin, and the sounds of the wild fall away.$A robed figure stands at a fork in the path, turning an hourglass over and over…
speaker: Time Wizard
introDialogue: Ohoho… I can see it, you know.$One of yours carries an echo — a shape it once wore eons ago, or one it has yet to wear.$I can pull that thread. But time… time always demands balance.
title: The Time Wizard
description:
The wizard offers to drag one of your Pokémon through time itself, remaking it as its ancient or futuristic Paradox relative.
But the timeline will fracture — and everyone else in your party will be reduced to a drifting Unown, keeping only their memories: their typing and their moves.

1.label: Accept the Bargain
1.tooltip:
(+) Chosen Pokémon becomes its Paradox form
(-) ALL other party members become Unown
1.eraPrompt: Which thread of time shall I pull?
1.selected: The wizard shatters the hourglass.$Sand pours upward. The world folds…

2.label: Refuse
2.selected: The wizard shrugs and rights the hourglass.$"Another timeline, perhaps."

invalidSelection: This Pokémon has no echo in another era.
transformationComplete:
When the world settles, {{paradoxName}} stands before you —
and the rest of your team drifts in eerie silence…
outro:
The fork in the path is empty.
Only a few grains of sand remain, falling slowly… upward.
